A FEW GOOD THINGS TO KNOW

Questions?
We’ve got you.

Need a little more help?
Say hello to our team

When will my jacket arrive?

We process orders within 1–3 business days. Once dispatched, tracked delivery to the United States typically takes 7–14 days. Shipping is free. We’ll email your tracking number as soon as your order ships.

Where do you ship from?

Orders ship directly from our manufacturing partner overseas. We currently deliver to addresses within the United States only.

How do I choose my size?

The cut is cropped and roomy, but sizes run smaller than standard US sizing. Compare our garment measurements with a jacket you own. If you’re between sizes, size up. .

What if it’s not quite right?

You can return unused items in their original packaging, with all accessories, within 30 days of delivery. Email support@valeandlark.com for the return address. You cover return shipping; there’s no restocking fee. Refunds of the item price are issued within 5–10 business days after receipt and inspection. Full return policy.

What’s inside the puffer?

Soft synthetic, down-alternative padding — no feathers. Both the shell and lining are polyester. The jacket is imported.

What if my order arrives damaged?

If your item is damaged, defective, or incorrect, email support@valeandlark.com within 30 days with a photo. We’ll arrange a free replacement or a full refund, with no return required.
